_rules: All visible copy lives here. Plain, short, specific. No em or en dashes anywhere. No metrics or numbers that are not needed. Banned words: leverage (verb), delve, landscape, showcase, pivotal, seamless, robust, empower (except 'Empower Sleep'), unlock, transform. Statuses must match reality: 'Live' only when the project is finished and running; 'In progress' otherwise, even if a demo is up.
name: Nate Victor

meta.title: Nate Victor
meta.description: Nate Victor, founder and CEO of MedStrata AI, building the fully autonomous back office for independent pharmacies. Going on side quests since 13.

hero.line: Started building & going on side quests at 13.

now.headline: I'm the founder and CEO of MedStrata AI.
now.text: We're building the fully autonomous back office for independent pharmacies.

sidequests.title: Things I build for fun.
sidequests.dek: Most of them run in your browser, so go poke around.

items.name: AI Race Engineer
items.line: A ghost replay of two real Formula 1 qualifying laps. Radio messages pop up where time was won or lost.

items.name: Argus
items.line: Quakes, fires, flights and satellites on a globe. Each line of its summary flies you to the event behind it.

items.name: Photoncar
items.line: A commute from a public dataset, laid out like a rally roadbook. Click a hard brake and the car's readings light up.

items.name: Imperium
items.line: A simulated drone spots a possible raft and asks permission to go look. Ignore it, and the answer is no.

items.name: Claude Learner
items.line: A study app for the Claude Certified Architect exam. Each lesson ends with you explaining the idea back.

items.name: USVC for iOS
items.line: An unofficial iPhone app concept for USVC. Invest pretend money in private tech companies.

more.name: Chisel
more.line: An AI agent that turns a sentence into a 3D part file. If the shape comes out broken, it tries again.

more.name: Sherlock Holmes AI
more.line: Text a research question to your own Telegram bot. It searches the web and sends back a report with links.

entries.title: Fantasy sports app
entries.text: Taught myself JavaScript and built a betting app for my friends and their dads. Apple rejected it because I was 13, not a licensed company.

entries.title: Online stores
entries.text: Built and ran them myself, and most lost to competitors.

entries.title: Real estate ads
entries.text: Older friends in real estate couldn't get Facebook ads to work, so I figured it out and sold them leads.

entries.title: Life insurance
entries.text: Got licensed and built a sales team, until chargebacks hit and it fell apart.

entries.title: Insuraflow AI
entries.text: Claude got me coding again. I built an AI system for life insurance agents, but they were the wrong audience.

entries.title: Empower Sleep
entries.text: Booked meetings for our account executive and learned to sell into healthcare.

about.title: I'm Nate.
text: I'm 20 and live in Red Bank, New Jersey. I skipped college and kept teaching myself.
Away from the keyboard, it's F1, chess, basketball, MMA, the gym and philosophy.

contact.title: Say hi.
contact.text: Building something, or just want to talk F1? Email me or book a call.

footer.note: Built with Vite and TypeScript. No framework.
